subject: CHANGES REQUESTED: S23-C batch 1 renal (acb5396): no zero-tolerance hit; stale cards.generated.json breaks CI, length cueing, 7 defects
body:
# S23-R verdict: S23-C batch 1 (renal & urinary, system 11), acb5396 (reviewed on claude/naadi-shared @ e10fdde)

**CHANGES REQUESTED.** No zero-tolerance hit in the sample, so a full re-review is NOT triggered. The fixes below are needed before approval.

## Automated (fresh local stack: own containers, ports 25432/25500/25529, loopback env only)
- `validate_content.py --pack renal-endo-nutrition`: 0 errors, 412 warnings (L10 149, L05 71, L08 52, L03 39, L06 28). Originality: fallback (near-dup check) passes.
- Migrate + `seed.py`: 4,717 changes, all post-checks ok. Second run: 0 changes (idempotent).
- `coverage.py`: all 10 system-11 areas are at or above the minimum of 6 on both Steps (step1 129 item-tags, step2ck 104). 11.01.01 S1 9/11 and 11.03.01 S1 9/10 are below target but above the minimum.
- Rendering (Playwright **WebKit**, iPad Pro 11 portrait and landscape, iPhone 13): section s23c-s110102-1-1 with figure, plus chart items. Layout is fine; no horizontal scroll on content pages; figures load from local Storage.

## Manual sample (stratified with `validate_content.py --sample`)
Items (26 of 172, 15%): s23c-q110501-1-04, -1-09, q110601-1-09, q110102-1-06, q110202-1-04, q110401-1-10, q110701-1-02, -1-08, q110201-1-05, q110601-1-02, -1-04, q110801-1-10, q110102-1-04, q110501-1-07, q110701-1-04, q110301-2-06, q110101-2-09, q110202-2-01, -2-04, q110401-2-06, -2-07, -2-08, q110701-2-02, q110801-2-05, -2-08, q110202-2-08.
Sections (5 of 28, 18%): s23c-s110102-1-1, s110801-1-1, s110401-1-3, s110101-2-1, s110401-2-2. All 12 renal figures were checked visually.
These were accurate against KDIGO 2024 CKD (SGLT2i eGFR ≥20, finerenone, bicarbonate <18, the 30% creatinine rule), AUA hematuria, AUA stones, ACOG UTI and USPSTF ASB. Keys, distractors and why-not text were sound. All figures are original SVG (naadi-original-v1) with no external refs; no licensed images.

## Defects
1. **CI break: `cards.generated.json` is stale.** It is committed as `[]`, but `python3 tools/generate_cards.py` produces 324 objective cards for this pack, so `generate_cards.py --check` in ci.yml fails. Run the generator and commit the result (this applies to batch 2 as well).
2. **No key facts marked.** There are 0 `<span class="hy">` in all 56 sections, so there are no cloze cards. CONTENT_AUTHORING §5 asks for 2–5 per section.
3. **Answer-length cueing (item-writing rule "no clues from length").** The key is the single longest option in 63/172 renal items (37%); chance is about 20%. Shorten keys or lengthen distractors, starting with the L05 warnings (for example s23c-q110102-1-06 and q110202-2-04). The key distribution is also skewed (E is the key in only 20/172).
4. **s23c-q110701-1-04 (stem excludes distractors).** The stem asks for a molecule "secreted by the metanephric mesenchyme", but options B, D and E each name a different source (AER, notochord, limb ectoderm), so they can be eliminated without knowledge. Drop the sources from the options.
5. **s23c-q110202-2-08 (explanation currency, key correct).** For cisplatin-eligible MIBC, perioperative durvalumab with neoadjuvant gemcitabine-cisplatin (NIAGARA; FDA approved 2025) is now a standard option. Why-not E ("checkpoint inhibitors ... for metastatic or cisplatin-ineligible settings") should mention perioperative use. Source: https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2408154
6. **Figure layout overlaps** (WebKit and Chromium): s23c-fig110701-1 (box text overflows its frame, and the horseshoe label crosses the aorta line), s23c-fig110801-1 ("Glomerulus" overflows its circle, and the "Proximal tubule" label sits on the tubule line), s23c-fig110202-1 (the "(blastema, stroma, epithelium)" text sits under the tubule path).
7. **Minor originality note.** The memory aid in s23c-s110601-1-1 ("Pee is Parasympathetic, Storage is Sympathetic") is close to a widely used review-book phrasing; consider rewording. It is not a verbatim famous mnemonic.

Re-review after the fixes: the changed items plus a fresh 5% spot check.
